# commit filling respects configuration and --no-fill.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T20:00:00Z'

mkdir repo
cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m Initial
gs repo init
gs branch create feature --no-commit

# -c remains available for other commit flags.
! gs commit create -c --allow-empty
stderr 'unknown.*-c'

git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
git config spice.message.fill true
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RESPONSE=$WORK/message.txt
gs commit create --allow-empty
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^Generated subject$'

# Disabling filling never invokes the command.
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=8
gs commit amend --no-fill --no-edit --allow-empty
! gs commit create --allow-empty
stderr 'status 8'
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^Generated subject$'

git config spice.message.fill false
gs commit amend --no-edit --allow-empty

-- message.txt --
Generated subject
